# P36.44 — Release cadence automation (REL-07; the `sig-sched-release-cut` + `sig-sched-materialize` drivers)

Manifest row 387 · Round 11 / P36 (sub-round 11C) · ticket
`docs/tickets/387_P36.44__release-cadence-automation.md` · catalog R11-REL-07.

## What lands

- **The cadence evaluator** — `ops/src/ops/release_cadence.py` builds
  `sig.release-cadence/1`: the shared drift evaluator P36.43's status
  lane names. The contract encodes verbatim —
  - **scheduled**: the cut fires on the *first weekday on/after the 15th
    at 14:00Z* (`sig-sched-release-cut` fires `0 14 15-17 * *`, the only
    three days that slot can land on — 2026-11-16 Mon / 2026-12-15 Tue
    are the window cell's literal instances — and the evaluator
    suppresses every non-first-weekday candidate);
  - **suppressed**: a Class S promotion within the previous 14 days
    suppresses the scheduled cut — read off the release journal's
    `promoted` `class` + `recorded_at`, a recorded fact never a guess;
  - **early**: net-new publishable claims ≥ 10 % of the release's
    published claims AND ≥ 14 days since the last promotion (absent
    delta inputs → `not_evaluable`, never a fabricated denominator);
  - **max age**: a release older than 35 days fires the recorded
    `release-max-age` alert (OBS.1 ledger + notifier seam); it cuts only
    when no cut is running (the journal's in-flight fold);
  - **freeze**: no cut starts inside an AR-3 window — a *recorded check*
    (`window.ar3` names it) on every evaluation, plus `release cut`'s
    own `assert_not_frozen`; withdraw/rollback are always allowed and
    never this evaluator's output.
- **`sig-ops release-cadence`** — evaluate → emit (`cadence/<ts>.json` +
  append-only `decisions.jsonl`) → recorded alert (exit 6) → journal →
  (decision=cut) `release cut` under `--apply`.
- **The leg driver + packet** — `ops/gcp/release-cadence.sh` (`--check`
  prints the verbatim leg offline; `--apply` is window + ADC + env +
  target-job gated → exit 42 `QUEUED` + the verbatim re-run prompt) and
  `docs/build/reports/p36.44-release-cadence/` (`prepared_not_executed`)
  + `D-P36.44-1` + `obligation-event/1` `:e0` anchor.
- **The weekly `sig-materialize` trigger** — `0 8 * * 0` (G1 §3.6
  verbatim: Sundays 08:00 UTC) invoking the existing job on its baked
  args — the read models lag `live` claims by at most 7 days
  (SIG-OPS-008). Its `[[manual_jobs]]` "no trigger by design" note flips
  in the same re-run commit per the live-diff contract.
